messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: - Amrix extended-release capsules are not recommended at all, because blood levels run about 40% higher and the drug stays in the body much longer (half-life of 50 hours versus 32 hours in younger adults). 2
- Tonmya is limited to the lower 2.8 mg dose once daily at bedtime. 3
Pregnancy:
Pregnancy guidance differs by product, so check which cyclobenzaprine product you use.
Tonmya (fibromyalgia): Based on animal data, Tonmya may increase the risk of neural tube defects when used two weeks before conception and through the first trimester. Because neural tube development happens early, often before pregnancy is recognized, avoid Tonmya during this window. Your healthcare provider should do a pregnancy test before you start Tonmya, and you should use effective contraception during treatment and for two weeks after the final dose. 3
Triples: [["Amrix extended-release capsules", "not recommended for", "all"], ["Amrix extended-release capsules", "has higher blood levels", "40% higher"], ["Amrix extended-release capsules", "has longer half life", "50 hours"], ["Amrix extended-release capsules", "has shorter half life in", "younger adults"], ["Tonmya", "has recommended dose", "2.8 mg once daily at bedtime"], ["Tonmya", "may increase risk of", "neural tube defects"], ["Tonmya", "used two weeks before conception and through", "first trimester"], ["Tonmya", "requires pregnancy test before starting", "healthcare provider"], ["Tonmya", "requires effective contraception during", "treatment"], ["Tonmya", "requires effective contraception for", "two weeks after final dose"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has pregnancy guidance", "differs by product"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "requires checking product", "used product"]]
Relations: ["has higher blood levels", "has longer half life", "has pregnancy guidance", "has recommended dose", "has shorter half life in", "may increase risk of", "not recommended for", "requires checking product", "requires effective contraception during", "requires effective contraception for", "requires pregnancy test before starting", "used two weeks before conception and through"]
Answer:

completion:
has higher blood levels: The subject drug results in blood levels that are higher by the specified percentage compared to a reference.
has longer half life: The subject drug has a longer half-life, meaning it remains in the body for a longer duration, as specified by the object entity.
has pregnancy guidance: The subject drug has specific pregnancy-related guidance that varies depending on the product, as indicated by the object entity.
has recommended dose: The subject drug has a specific recommended dosage regimen, as specified by the object entity.
has shorter half life in: The subject drug has a shorter half-life in the specified population compared to other groups.
may increase risk of: The subject drug may increase the risk of the specified medical condition or adverse event.
not recommended for: The subject drug is not recommended for the specified group or situation.
requires checking product: The subject drug requires the user to check the specific product they are using, as indicated by the object entity.
requires effective contraception during: The subject drug requires the use of effective contraception during the specified period.
requires effective contraception for: The subject drug requires the use of effective contraception for the specified duration after the final dose.
requires pregnancy test before starting: The subject drug requires a pregnancy test to be conducted by the specified entity before starting treatment.
used two weeks before conception and through: The subject drug is used during the specified time period before conception and throughout the specified stage of pregnancy.
